mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for future corporate cash flows and increases equity valuation multiples, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 200.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based recovery in consumer demand, which increases corporate revenue visibility and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below its 12-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate profitability expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising FEDFUNDS rate, signals inflationary pressure that triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term between CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate below 4.8% and a rise in non-farm payroll growth above 150k signals a tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and reduce equity risk appetite, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with wage pressure
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases where both UNRATE < 4.8 and PAYEMS > 150.0, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below its 6-month moving average, combined with a drop in housing starts, indicates weakening consumer demand and a contraction in residential investment, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST are declining, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 100.0, combined with a concurrent drop in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.5% annualized, signals a manufacturing and real economy slowdown, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO < 100.0 and GDPC1 < 1.5, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.
